function.name: create_hold

function.name: capture_payment

function.name: confirm_reservation
function.description: Confirm a valid unexpired hold after its quoted deposit is successfully paid.

function.name: release_hold
function.description: Release a temporary hold without a cancellation fee, explicitly freeing all date inventory.

function.name: expire_hold

function.name: change_dates

function.name: change_room_type

function.name: assign_room

function.name: unassign_room
function.description: Release a confirmed booking room assignment before check-in while retaining type inventory and deposit.

function.name: cancel_reservation
function.description: Cancel a confirmed booking, release date inventory and assignment, record its frozen-time rate-plan fee. Use release_hold for tentative bookings.

function.name: refund_reservation
function.description: Refund with an immutable key, bounded by actual paid balance less cancellation fees or real active-booking overpayment.

function.name: mark_room_clean
function.description: Housekeeping or manager marks an unoccupied room clean. An occupied room cannot be cleaned through this operation.

function.name: set_room_maintenance
function.description: Manager locks/unlocks a room for maintenance. Locking cannot invalidate existing assignments or room-type bookings.

function.name: check_in

function.name: swap_room
function.description: Atomically move a checked-in stay to another clean available room of the same type/property; release old occupancy, dirty old room, update assignment and stay.

function.name: check_out
function.description: Check out an occupied stay, release assignment/date inventory, clear current room stay and mark the room dirty.

function.name: change_calendar_limit
function.description: Manager changes the sale limit of a resource calendar-day ID, bounded by physical type rooms and existing bookings.

function.name: set_calendar_closed

function.name: verify_guest
function.description: Front desk asks the independent identity simulator to verify the reservation guest. Do not supply an identity outcome or external attestation.

function.name: get_property
function.description: Query public property policy and configuration.

function.name: get_availability
function.description: Query public per-night capacity, held/booked counts and available inventory for the property/type/date interval.

function.name: get_room
function.description: Query scoped staff room state; a guest assigned here sees public room identification only.

function.name: get_reservation

function.name: get_guest

function.name: get_payment_ledger

function.name: get_calendar_day

function.name: get_rate_plan
function.description: Query public deposit and cancellation policy for a property rate plan.
